18 years ago, Steve Jobs stood on stage at the MacWorld Expo and said, “Every once in a while, a revolutionary product comes along that changes everything.” Then, he revealed iPhone. A device that was so far ahead of its time, that it looked more like the phones we use today, than the ones we used in 2007. iPhone has come a long way over the past two decades. So let’s take a closer look at its history and how it grew into the device we use today.
title: History of the iPhone (Full Documentary)
